ac-us-nkit-iso.label: Animal Crossing US NKit ISO
ac-us-nkit-iso.notes: NKit images must be patched from an exact source hash; this tool does not normalize NKit to ISO.

releases.label: AC Deluxe 0.38.1
releases.summary: Patch 38.1 includes new e+ behavior fixes, island crash fixes, golden tool progression fixes, and a save-version upgrade.
changelog: The new e+ fish have their correct sound effects when biting and caught.
The hercules beetle has its correct sound effect when being scared away.
The pinball furniture item plays its sound effect from its "front" face now, instead of its "side" face.
The TV with VCR now previews its animation in the catalog.
A crash that could occur when going to the island has been fixed.
The islander should no longer get stuck indoors indefinitely.

Receiving a golden watering can before receiving a golden axe will no longer lock the player out of receiving the golden axe as well. Once more, a one-time reset to the golden axe flag will be applied when upgrading to this patch version.
K.K. live performances have the proper beat tempo after upgrading to the e+ audiorom.
A bunch of other minor e+ decomp fixes have been added. There are still a lot that need to be brought over.
Since this version includes a save-version upgrade, back up your save file before launching it!

releases.label: AC Deluxe 0.38.2
releases.summary: Patch 38.2 includes several gameplay and visual bug fixes, improved N64 clock behavior, corrected dialogue and catalog text issues, added e+ fishing tourney messages, and expands player animation data with fixes for animation rotation clipping.
changelog: Fixed N64 banti fadeout behavior when opening submenus.
Fixed eel shadows reverting incorrectly after scare-away or bite-failure states.
Fixed rainbow rendering.
Fixed needlework NPC talk state selection for what_happen vs other_happen.
Fixed inverted fish/insect completion dialogue in quest greetings.
Fixed catalog item names for item1 entries with furniture variants.
Added all player animation data.
Fixed rotation clipping on some player animations.
Improved wade-disabled player behavior by consistently running Player_actor_Set_ScrollDemo_forWade across states.
Fixed N64 clock display so midnight and noon show as 12.
Added acre locations to all non-perfect shrine/plaza hints.
Added fish messages for e+ fish during the fishing tourney.

releases.label: AC Deluxe 0.38.3
releases.summary: Patch 38.3 makes fruit baskets valid for fruit villager quests, fixes a softlock when changing shirts, and more!
changelog: Clovers are no longer counted as weeds when doing town assessment.
Updated Farley's shrine spawn positioning.
Fruit baskets are valid for fruit villager quests.
Re-planting grown flowers in a hole is more natural looking.
Chip will now give players a free fishing rod if they do not have one during Fishing Tournies.
Fixed softlock when pressing B while changing from a regular shirt to a custom design.
Fixed some player tools which were marked invalid for Player-to-Player Nook codes.
Fixed some paintings not being reorderable.
Fixed Farley's model transparency.

releases.label: AC Deluxe 0.39.0
releases.summary: Patch 39.0 adds monkey villagers, custom animations, and tons of bug fixes!
changelog: Added monkey villager type based on Porter!
Added Champ & Nana, with the rest of the Wild World villagers coming in a later patch!
Added the ability to fill in dirt holes by pressing B without a shovel.
Holes no longer disappear on acre change, and now disappear when reloading the map instead.
Added a custom watering can animation. This animation will be revised in the future
Renna placement now uses an ask/nudge/confirm dialogue; items under the sign are sent to the police station, and buried items no longer block placement.
Fixed Renna's offer list sometimes containing duplicate decorations.
Wisp spirits only spawn on unchanged ground and adjust their height to the tile beneath them. They will not spawn on top of buildings anymore.
Building collision now persists correctly, preventing NPCs and insects from spawning on footprints before buildings load. No more NPCs on top of houses!
Improved dropped design rendering performance.
Presents can always be multi-selected for opening.
Fixed stackable items inside presents being able to be stacked together.
Bank, loan repayment, and address book menus now support D-Pad and keyboard cursor movement.
Fixed the town map showing stale data when travelling to a new town.
Fanfares no longer interrupt field BGM.
Fixed swapping fish or insects with other fish/insects causing odd behavior.
Fish and insects can no longer be multi-selected while indoors.
Copper will only mention Gulliver while his event is not complete.
Fixed dung beetles mishandling when their ball despawns.
Fixed black roses watered with the golden can losing their golden can watered status every field load.
Fixed door areas being invalid spots to stand up.
Fixed thunder effect timing.
Pond frog sounds only play when a frog is present.
Re-implemented & improved NES emulator FDS audio.
Legend of Zelda and other NES games should now render in Dolphin without changing texture cache safety. This may slightly impact performance on emulator only.
Opening the mailbox while holding a watering can will no longer water the mailbox before opening it.

releases.label: AC Deluxe 0.39.1
releases.summary: Patch 39.1 fixes some bugs, overhauls how data is loaded, and adds an e+ style title screen animation for the "Deluxe" logo.
changelog: Added an e+ style title screen animation for the "Deluxe" logo.
Furniture now loads from disk via leaf RELs, reclaiming a large amount of ram for future content.
Acre data now loads from disk as well.
Renna's payment dialogue now shows the wallet UI when bells are involved.
Fanfare fade-in/out windows are shorter for snappier transitions.
Fixed Porter's travel cutscene being interrupted when other NPCs walked onto the station (vanilla bug).
Fixed structure collision placement for fireworks stall/New Year's table and bridge variants.
Fixed holes not resetting when entering event maps (regression from 39.0's hole persistence change).
Fixed a beep noise when catching a bee while being chased (bee chase BGM colliding with the catch fanfare).
Fixed bee texture alignment which may have caused weird bee textures.
